presentation.settingsDescription: Plan journeys, check departures and follow step-by-step instructions without a map. Show map opens a map for what you are viewing without changing this setting.
presentation.settingsVisionNote: Separate from the vision-impaired travel profile, which changes how route results are laid out.
presentation.mapDisclosureBody: Map files are downloaded once from this app's server and kept on this device, so the map also works offline later. Your starting view stays Text mode.
tripStart.heading: Start trip guidance
tripStart.intro: When the trip starts, your browser asks for permission:
tripStart.location: Location, to follow your progress along the trip and move to the next step. Your position is used on this device.
tripStart.notifications: Notifications, for get-off alerts that tell you when your stop is near.
tripStart.optional: You can decline. Guidance still lists every step and its times.
nearby.none: No departures in the next hour.
nearby.noLocation: Choose a stop to see its departures and the stops around it, or use your location.
nearby.locationUnavailable: Your location is unavailable. Choose a stop instead.
nearby.locateExplain: Your browser asks for permission first. Your position is used on this device to sort stops by distance.
flow.networkAddress: Your network (IP) address and ordinary browser details
flow.field.resource: Which public data files are needed
flow.field.stopCentroid: A public stop location near you
flow.field.routingRequirements: Journey needs such as step-free routes
flow.changeLater: You can change this later in Settings. Turning it off stops new requests; it cannot undo requests already made.
mapDetail.heading: Use detailed maps?
mapDetail.details: {provider} supplies streets, buildings and place names. As you move the map, it requests the map pieces for the area on screen, so {provider} learns which areas you look at. Detailed maps use more data than the minimal map, depending on how much you move around. Pieces you have seen are kept in this browser's cache for a while.
mapDetail.hint: Streets and place names are available with detailed maps.
mapStatus.absent: This city has no minimal map yet. Stops, departures and journey planning work as usual.
mapStatus.failed: The minimal map could not be loaded. Stops, departures and journey planning still work.
mapStatus.offline: The minimal map needs a connection the first time. Stops, departures and journey planning still work.
mapStatus.detailedFailed: Detailed map unavailable. Showing the minimal map.
liveTimes.noneReported: No live updates for these departures right now.
liveTimes.stale: Live times may be out of date (last updated {time}).
liveTimes.heading: Show live times?
liveTimes.details: While a stop's departures are on screen, the app asks this app's server for current delays and cancellations about every 30 seconds. The server learns which stop or area you are viewing.
liveTimes.unavailable: Scheduled times for this stop aren't on this device yet.
serviceAlerts.heading: Service alerts
serviceAlerts.stale: Alerts may be out of date (last received {time}).
serviceAlerts.failed: Service alerts could not be loaded. The app will try again.
serviceAlerts.refreshFailed: Alerts could not be refreshed (last checked {time}).
serviceAlerts.unavailable: {city} does not publish service alerts to this app.
serviceAlerts.unavailableGeneric: This city does not publish service alerts to this app.
serviceAlerts.tripSevere: Severe service alert on your trip: {header}
serviceAlerts.offerGeneric: Service alerts are available for this city.
serviceAlerts.offerDetails: While a stop, line or route is on screen, the app asks this app's server for {city}'s alerts about once a minute. The request names only the city, never the stop, line or trip you are viewing.
whatsNew.heading: What's new
whatsNew.serviceAlerts.title: Service alerts
whatsNew.serviceAlerts.body: See disruptions, detours and cancellations on stop departures, lines, route results and trip guidance, where your city publishes them.
whatsNew.serviceAlerts.later: You can turn them on later in Settings.
